answer.rationale: Release went out 2 hours ago and p99 write latency has been climbing for 90 minutes inside the primary region during peak settlement load. This matches the exact pattern in b1: a recent release produced a spike that a rollback cleared without customer impact. Settlement peak makes write preservation the dominant constraint — failover (b2) shifts traffic cleanly but does not guarantee write durability during an in-flight peak, whereas rollback removes the suspect binary and keeps writes flowing on the prior stable build. The release-timing correlation is the strongest causal signal available within the verification budget, so rollback is the single intervention with the best expected availability / write-preservation tradeoff right now.
